root_cause_analysis.symptom: 14 cycle-1 dormant renderers never receive tool-call-start/end envelopes; no custom cards render for subagent verbs, MCP verbs, dynamic tools, or plan updates
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: codexAppServerClient.ts:364 `return method.startsWith('item/')` silently returns true for ALL unhandled item/* methods BEFORE the eventHandler fires. This early return swallows collabAgentToolCall, dynamicToolCall, mcpToolCall, and plan item types without emitting any EventMsg. The mapper never sees these events.

development_approach.strategy: Option 2 EventMsg discriminator naming (per-item-type-family with verb in a field). Each item.type gets ONE begin EventMsg discriminator and ONE end EventMsg discriminator. The mapper reads the embedded verb field to construct the knownTools key. This avoids 26+ per-verb discriminators and matches Codex's actual item-taxonomy.

event_msg_contract.collab_agent_call_begin: { type: 'collab_agent_call_begin', call_id, callId, tool: CollabAgentTool, prompt, model, senderThreadId, agentsStates }
event_msg_contract.collab_agent_call_end: { type: 'collab_agent_call_end', call_id, callId, tool: CollabAgentTool, status }
event_msg_contract.dynamic_tool_call_begin: { type: 'dynamic_tool_call_begin', call_id, callId, namespace, tool, arguments }
event_msg_contract.dynamic_tool_call_end: { type: 'dynamic_tool_call_end', call_id, callId, tool, namespace, status, success }
event_msg_contract.mcp_tool_call_begin: { type: 'mcp_tool_call_begin', call_id, callId, server, tool, arguments }
event_msg_contract.mcp_tool_call_end: { type: 'mcp_tool_call_end', call_id, callId, server, tool, status }
event_msg_contract.image_view: { type: 'image_view', call_id, callId, path } (optional; emitted on item/completed only)
